insights: Closed IR kind tags and specialized construction keep type-erased observations distinguishable across module/function/loop/machine/SCC levels. Cast access returns const pointers.

The nullptr construction assertion is not a lifetime proof: the wrapper is non-owning and requires the underlying IR to remain alive. It does not prove semantic validity or justify cached analysis retention.

Ink already has a private CheckedModule wrapper with immutable program access. F028 should carry that checked type through analysis and emission APIs instead of raw Program plus a caller-trusted flag. Use Rust lifetimes/ownership for borrowed diagnostics; no portable pointer identity or new runtime tagging machinery is required.
